credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/orchid.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: LOOMING: Flora Vance's ace. The great magenta moth flower thrust at the foe on a swan-neck spike, wings spread in threat, a hooked plum lip like a claw; glossy plum leaves on silver root claws. Intro: the wings are folded; they SPREAD wide, hold, and settle. Crystal rule: plum is the dark slot (leaves, spike, lip, shade), magenta the light; the roots are the shared white. Sport: the harlequin moth orchid (cream-gold petals, maroon-black lip and leaves).
